output.tldr: HAL benefits from a massive order book, robust margins, and zero debt, but faces persistent LCA delivery delays and severe working capital deterioration.

promises.promise: Revenue growth of 10% from FY25 onwards.
promises.actual: FY25 turnover grew 7% to Rs 30,105 crores, missing the guidance.

promises.promise: Maintain operating EBITDA margin around 31% for FY26.
promises.actual: FIN reports annual operating margin averaged 30% in FY26.
promises.why: Achieved operating margin very close to the 31% target.

promises.promise: Deliver 16 LCA Mk1A aircraft annually starting FY25.
promises.actual: Established production capacity is only 8 LCA per annum.
promises.why: Production capacity falls short of contracted delivery schedule.

promises.promise: Expect double-digit revenue growth of 10% to 12% minimum for FY27.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 revenue grew 14.4% and 14.8% YoY.
promises.why: Actual quarterly revenue growth exceeds minimum guidance.

promises.promise: Five-year capex outlay of Rs 14,000 to Rs 15,000 crore.
promises.actual: Capex is ongoing across multiple years, assessment incomplete.
promises.why: Multi-year capex plan is still in progress.

promises.promise: EBITDA margin will settle down at 26% to 27%.
promises.actual: FIN shows FY25 and FY26 margins came in at 31% and 30%.
promises.why: Margins remained higher than the conservative 26-27% projection.

credibility.line: Mixed execution; revenue and margin guidance are reasonably close, but physical volume targets like LCA deliveries face recurring delays.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management guides for 16 LCA Mark-1A aircraft deliveries annually.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Nashik third production line established capacity is only 8 LCA per annum.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management expects steady revenue growth of 8% to 10% for FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN reports Q2 FY26 revenue of 6,629 cr with 10.9% YoY growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims strong operating leverage and profit compounding faster than sales.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 3y CAGR shows PAT at 16.1% versus revenue at 7.1%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management states debt/equity is well-managed and company is debt-free.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN confirms debt-to-equity ratio is 0.00 with minimal borrowings.

bull.point: Exceptional cash generation supports strong balance sheet health.
bull.evidence: Operating cash flow to PAT ratio is 1.44x over 5 years.

bull.point: Massive order book provides long-term revenue visibility.
bull.evidence: Order book improved to Rs 1,89,300 crores after annual turnover.

bull.point: Operating margins remain remarkably robust and stable.
bull.evidence: Operating margins consistently hover around 24% to 39% across quarters.

bear.point: Severe working capital deterioration threatens cash flow quality.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened significantly from 475 to 788 days.

bear.point: Persistent delivery delays in key aircraft programs like LCA.
bear.evidence: Production capacity limited to 8 LCA per annum versus 16 targeted.

bear.point: Corporate governance and compliance failures highlighted by auditors.
bear.evidence: Audit committee was not validly constituted from April to June 2025.

watch_next: Actual LCA Mark-1A delivery numbers against the 20-unit target.
Resolution of SEBI and Companies Act board composition non-compliance issues.
Improvement or stabilization in the lengthening cash conversion cycle.
